explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: Atracurium besylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
The product used at both Corvale sites carries NDC 55150021710 and labeler AuroMedics Pharma LLC.
That NDC's SPL set ID f7b6a720 names Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) as the registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspected that plant on 2026-02-06 and classified it OAI; the classification was posted on 2026-09-21.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2024-08-15 following an earlier OAI inspection.
The recommended action is to transfer 20 vials of 100 mg/10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains 20 days.

rejected.text: The OAI posting occurred 257 days after the inspection end date.
